result.topic_en: Calculations using Riemann's integration method for a linear hyperbolic equation in characteristic coordinates r, s (the telegraph-type equation $\partial^2 w/\partial r\partial s - m(\partial w/\partial r + \partial w/\partial s)=0$), transformed to variables σ = r+s, u = r−s and solved by Fourier cosine integrals in u.

$\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial\sigma^2}-2m\frac{\partial w}{\partial\sigma}+\mu\mu w=0\quad \psi_1(\sigma)\quad\psi_2(\sigma)$
$\frac{\partial^2\psi}{\partial\sigma^2}-2m\frac{\partial\psi}{\partial\sigma}+\mu\mu\psi=0$

$\frac{\partial^2\psi}{\partial\sigma'^2}-2m\frac{\partial\psi}{\partial\sigma'}+\mu\mu\psi=0$
$\sigma=\sigma'\ \psi=0.\ \frac{\partial\psi}{\partial\sigma'}=-1$
$\psi_1\psi_2''-\psi_2\psi_1''=2m(\psi_1\psi_2'-\psi_2\psi_1')$
$\psi_1\psi_2'-\psi_2\psi_1'=e^{\int 2m\partial\sigma}$

$w'=\int_0^\infty\cos\mu(u-u')\left(\chi(\mu)f(\sigma')+\psi(\mu)\varphi(\sigma')\right)\partial\mu=\frac1\pi\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\int_0^\infty\cos\mu(u-u')\ w\ \partial u\,\partial\mu\ (\sigma'=\sigma)$
$\frac{\partial w'}{\partial\sigma'}=\int_0^\infty\cos\mu(u-u')\left(\chi(\mu)f'(\sigma')+\psi(\mu)\varphi'(\sigma')\right)\partial\mu=\frac1\pi\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\int_0^\infty\cos\mu(u-u')\frac{\partial w}{\partial\sigma}\partial u\,\partial\mu\ \ \sigma'=\sigma$
$\chi(\mu)f(\sigma)+\psi(\mu)\varphi(\sigma)=\frac1\pi\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\cos\mu(u-u')\,w\,\partial u$
$\chi(\mu)f'(\sigma)+\psi(\mu)\varphi'(\sigma)=\frac1\pi\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\cos\mu(u-u')\frac{\partial w}{\partial\sigma}\partial u$
$\chi(\mu)=\frac{\varphi'(\sigma)w-\frac{\partial w}{\partial\sigma}\varphi(\sigma)}{f(\sigma)\varphi'(\sigma)-\varphi(\sigma)f'(\sigma)}\quad \psi(\mu)=\frac{\frac{\partial w}{\partial\sigma}f(\sigma)-w f'(\sigma)}{f(\sigma)\varphi'(\sigma)-\varphi(\sigma)f'(\sigma)}$

$w'=\frac1\pi\int_0^\infty\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\cos\mu(u-u')\,\partial u\,\partial\mu\left(\frac{f(\sigma')\varphi'(\sigma)-\varphi(\sigma')f'(\sigma)}{f(\sigma)\varphi'(\sigma)-\varphi(\sigma)f'(\sigma)}w+\frac{\partial w}{\partial\sigma}\frac{f(\sigma)\varphi(\sigma')-\varphi(\sigma)f(\sigma')}{f(\sigma)\varphi'(\sigma)-\varphi(\sigma)f'(\sigma)}\right)$
$v=\frac2\pi\int_0^\infty\cos\mu(u-u')\,\partial\mu\,\frac{f(\sigma')\varphi(\sigma)-\varphi(\sigma')f(\sigma)}{f(\sigma)\varphi'(\sigma)-\varphi(\sigma)f'(\sigma)}$

methods.what: Green-type integral identity (integration by parts) for the hyperbolic operator with adjoint function v, reducing a double integral to boundary line integrals
methods.quote: $=\int v\left(\frac{\partial w}{\partial s}-mw\right)ds-\int w\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial r}+mv\right)dr$

methods.what: Change to coordinates σ=r+s, u=r−s transforming the equation
Riemann-type representation of solution at (r',s') via integral along σ = const plus boundary terms
Separation with cos μu giving ODE in σ with initial conditions for the auxiliary function
Abel/Liouville formula for the Wronskian of the ODE
Fourier integral solution of the Cauchy problem, solving for coefficients χ(μ), ψ(μ) from initial data w and ∂w/∂σ
Fourier integral expression for the Riemann function v
